items.title: Hong Kong moves to extend crypto licensing rules to brokers, advisers and custodians
items.summary: Hong Kong wants to bring crypto brokers, advisers, asset managers and custodians under its existing regulatory framework.

items.title: U.S. Senate passes bill to ban prediction market bets on war and death
items.summary: The bill would ban bets on war, assassinations and military operations amid concerns that traders could profit from inside information, as has already occurred.

items.title: Live news: Bitcoin hovers just above $61,000 as Anthropic slides after Nasdaq debut
items.summary: BlackRock’s bitcoin ETF saw a record $541.1 million outflow as the U.S. tech selloff spread to Asia, sending South Korea’s Kospi down more than 5%.

items.title: Bitcoin bots pounced within seconds when researchers exposed their wallet keys
items.summary: University of Liège researchers put a few dollars into deliberately vulnerable bitcoin addresses and watched rival bots race for the money within seconds.

items.title: ECB’s Lagarde warns Europe could lose control of growing tokenized asset market
items.summary: The ECB president called for common rules as the EU's new blockchain settlement system handled a 1 billion-euro ($1.1 billion) digital bond transaction.

items.title: Bitcoin, stocks and gold traders getting nervous, and volatility gauges are surging
items.summary: Your day-ahead look for Nov. 20, 2026

items.title: Bitcoin drops for third straight day as Asian tech shares slide
items.summary: BlackRock’s spot bitcoin ETF recorded the largest single-day outflow since its introduction more than two years ago as investors continued to flee the sector.

items.title: Coinbase targets first-half 2027 for its own prediction market contracts
items.summary: The move would reduce Coinbase's reliance on a partnership Kalshi, which brought in $200 million in annualized revenue in the third quarter.

items.title: No special rules for Hyperliquid or other onchain trading platforms, CFTC says
items.summary: Hyperliquid and other onchain exchanges can offer derivatives to U.S. traders if they obtain the required licenses or work with a registered exchange, the CFTC chairman said.

items.title: Cathie Wood's Ark Invest piled into Anthropic IPO, buying $90 million worth of shares
items.summary: ARK Invest snapped up $90 million in Anthropic stock across six funds during the AI maker’s historic Nasdaq debut while offloading Nvidia shares amid leadership turmoil.

items.title: US Senate advances prediction market restrictions with DEATH BETS Act
items.summary: The Senate-approved bill would ban prediction market contracts tied to war, assassination and death amid concerns over potential insider trading on military events.

items.title: Bitcoin price drops to $60K as Anthropic drops to $87 in tech sell-off
items.summary: Bitcoin price strength felt pressure from falling US equities as traders reassessed AI prospects after Anthropic’s IPO.

items.title: DBS bets it can lose the deposit and keep the client
items.summary: The Singapore bank earned a record $208 million in transaction services fees in the third quarter — now it’s helping companies turn deposits into stablecoins they can spend without it.

items.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
items.summary: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

items.title: Lagarde warns Europe could miss chance to unify tokenized markets
items.summary: The ECB president said Europe’s market for tokenized securities could split into platforms that cannot settle trades with one another.

items.title: Binance hacker moves nearly $600M in ETH, routes funds through THORChain, Chainflip
items.summary: OnChain Lens tracked nearly $600 million in ETH transfers over two days as the Binance hackers moved the stolen funds through fresh wallets and cross-chain protocols to obscure their trail.

items.title: VanEck to end Gemini ETF custody deals, keeps Coinbase
items.summary: VanEck plans to end Gemini’s custody agreements for three crypto ETFs in February 2027, while Coinbase will continue serving as a custodian for the funds.

items.title: Bitcoin nears repeat of chart pattern that preceded 2023’s $25K retest
items.summary: Bitcoin’s 21-day moving average fell below its 200-day average, and analyst Keith Alan expects a second bearish crossover by Sunday.

items.title: BlackRock’s IBIT loses record $541M amid Anthropic market debut
items.summary: BlackRock’s IBIT posted its largest daily outflow on record, taking three-session outflows near $900 million as BTC dipped amid a broader market selloff.

items.title: SEC charges 8 firms over fake crypto platforms tied to $37M fraud
items.summary: Fraudsters allegedly used social media ads, chat groups and forged SEC filings to defraud US investors of approximately $37 million.

items.title: Senate Passes Bill Banning Prediction Market Bets on War, Terrorism and Death
items.summary: Sen. Adam Schiff's DEATH BETS Act would bar U.S.-regulated exchanges from listing contracts tied to war, assassinations or deaths.

items.title: Morning Minute: Anthropic IPO Pops, Sinks Markets
items.summary: A (brief) win for Anthropic's ANT stock on IPO day meant a loss for just about every other major asset class.

items.title: MoonPay Applies for National Trust Bank Charter to Grow Custody and Stablecoin Business
items.summary: The crypto payments firm joins a rush of crypto companies seeking federal trust charters, which face growing political scrutiny.

items.title: Bitcoin ETFs Shed $582M in a Day as BTC Drops Below $62K
items.summary: Thursday's ETF outflow was the funds' biggest in three weeks, as rising Treasury yields and Fed rate hike bets weigh on crypto.

items.title: Coinbase Targets In-House Prediction Markets by First Half of 2027: Report
items.summary: The exchange offers event contracts through Kalshi, but running its own would give it more control and a bigger share of trading revenue.

items.title: CryptoUK Urges FCA Not to Treat DeFi Devs as Regulated by Default
items.summary: The UK crypto trade group broadly backed the regulator's proposed perimeter guidance, but warned that parts of it go further than the law.

items.title: Citi Says Customers Are Responsible When AI Banking Agents Go Rogue—Even After a Hack
items.summary: Citibank’s updated terms put customers on the hook for outside AI agents, including leaked logins.

items.title: Nvidia, AMD, Micron Sink as Anthropic Closes 17% Above IPO Price
items.summary: Anthropic shares opened 34% above their $83 IPO price before giving up much of the gain, while Nvidia, AMD and other AI stocks slid across Wall Street.

items.title: Meet SHRINCS: Bitcoin's Emerging Frontrunner for a Post-Quantum Signature
items.summary: A new post-quantum signature proposal aims to secure Bitcoin’s future, but balancing user safety and efficiency comes with hurdles.

items.title: Hackers Leak Visa, Mastercard and JPMorgan Customer Data
items.summary: A ransomware group breached third-party vendors, not the companies’ own systems. Visa said no card data was affected while Mastercard cited a limited cardholder subset.
